consular.mission: Australian Consulate, Helsinki; Australian Embassy, Stockholm
consular.notes: Australia has a consulate in Finland, headed by an Honorary Consul. It provides limited consular assistance. The consulate can't provide visa or immigration services or issue passports. You can get full consular assistance from the Australian Embassy in Stockholm, Sweden.
